mapper.sql: SELECT d.document_id AS documentId,d.document_code AS documentCode,v.version_id AS versionId,f.fragment_id AS fragmentId,d.document_title AS title,f.body_text AS body,TO_CHAR(d.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updatedAt

FROM document_fragment f JOIN document_version v ON v.version_id=f.version_id AND v.version_state='PUBLISHED' JOIN document d ON d.document_id=v.document_id AND d.current_version_id=v.version_id AND d.document_status IN ('APPROVED','IN_REVIEW') JOIN employee viewer ON viewer.employee_code=#{employee} AND viewer.employment_status='ACTIVE' JOIN employee_account account ON account.employee_id=viewer.employee_id AND account.account_status='ACTIVE' WHERE f.ai_searchable='Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employee_role role WHERE role.employee_id=viewer.employee_id AND role.role_code='EMPLOYEE' AND role.revoked_at IS NULL) AND (d.document_scope='COMPANY' OR d.document_scope='DEPARTMENT' AND d.department_id=viewer.department_id OR d.owner_employee_id=viewer.employee_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_grant grant_row WHERE grant_row.document_id=d.document_id AND grant_row.employee_id=viewer.employee_id AND grant_row.permission_code='READ' AND grant_row.revoked_at IS NULL))
mapper.select: AND (INSTR(d.document_title,#{query})>0 OR INSTR(d.document_category,#{query})>0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(f.body_text,#{query})>0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_tag t WHERE t.document_id=d.document_id AND INSTR(t.tag_value,#{query})>0)) ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC,d.document_id DESC,f.fragment_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
AND d.document_id=#{documentId} AND v.version_id=#{versionId} AND f.fragment_id=#{fragmentId}
